Done. I implemented `listTools` and `callTool` in `server.mjs`.

## Summary

**`listTools`** returns two tool definitions:
- `note_create` — input schema requires `title` and `body` (both strings)
- `note_get` — input schema requires `note_id` (string)

**`callTool`** dispatches by tool name:
- **`note_create`**: validates that `title` and `body` are present, non-empty strings (rejects otherwise with a thrown error). Stores the note in an in-memory `Map` and returns a `content` array with a single `text` item. IDs are stable and generated sequentially (`n1`, `n2`, …), and the returned text embeds the id so callers can retrieve it (matching the test's `/n\d+/` extraction).
- **`note_get`**: validates that `note_id` is a non-empty string and that a note with that id exists (throws `note not found` otherwise). Returns structured `text` content with the note's id, title, and body.
- Any other tool name throws `unknown tool: <name>`, which the existing `protocol.mjs` framing translates into a `-32602` JSON-RPC error.

All tests pass (2/2), and I verified edge cases (unknown tool, missing/empty title, missing body, missing/unknown `note_id`) all reject correctly.
